# ponte_agent_group (Resource)

An agent group. Policies target groups through subjects; agents join through ponte_agent_group_member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ponte_agent_group" "claims" {
  name        = "Claims"
  description = "Claims handling agents"
  owner       = "claims-platform@example.com"
  tags        = ["finance", "prod"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `max_concurrent_agents` (Number) Cap on simultaneously active member agents.
- `owner` (String) The owning person or team.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags. Order does not matter.
- `trust_level` (String) The group's trust level (associate by default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group id (grp_…).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ponte_agent_group.claims grp_0123456789ab
```
